deltaDescription: Added to what is stored. Negative to take stock out.
incomingTooltip: Inbound stock from open (draft) goods receipts. Excludes received and cancelled.
neverCounted: Never counted — no stock record yet.

notifications.conflict: Someone else changed this stock — the latest count is shown. Check it and save again.

onHandDescription: The counted total. It replaces what is stored, and may be negative for a back-order.
outgoingTooltip: Held by open sales orders. Counts against what can be promised, not yet against stock.
title: Stock

validation.deltaRequired: A change of zero writes nothing
validation.willGoNegative: This leaves stock below zero — recorded as a back-order.
